description: Single authority for the physical layout of every writable runtime location. service/platform/project_root.py (Python) and config/js/var_paths.js (Node) both resolve paths from THIS file; native/Rust never guesses a path, it receives explicit --data-dir arguments from the launcher. Two independent roots: VAR_ROOT (runtime data/state/logs; <repo>/var or <userData>/var) and AUTH_ROOT (secret material: local IPC tokens only; per-user %LOCALAPPDATA%, never inside the repository or an installer). A source checkout and an installed app are two flavors with their own per-user directories (flavors below), so one can run, be installed or be uninstalled without touching the other's window layout, data or tokens.

retired_env.description: Names no launcher sets any more. A process that still receives one refuses to resolve its paths instead of ignoring it, so an old script can never put its data somewhere else than it expects.

config.note: Versioned config revisions (<domain>/revisions, pointer.json), Health apply operations (operations/) and bootstrap run records (bootstrap/). Separate from business data (06 section 3).

storage.description: Everything that grows without bound lives under the storage location the user picks in 設定 → 資料儲存 (config domain storage_location, field historical_root; null = <data root>/<default_dir>). VAR_ROOT keeps only data of steady size: the WAL, the session cache, state, config and logs. The raw-history partitions (names starting with a root_prefixes entry) sit at the location itself; every child below is a path under it. Health moves every owned entry together when the location changes (config/js/storage_settings.js); config/storage_settings.py and config/js/storage_settings.js read the active location, service/platform/project_root.py and config/js/var_paths.js resolve the children from it.
